column2: Course Description: This course introduces academic speaking and listening skills to international students through readings and speech manuscripts in order to develop oral communication skills. Students are expected to speak frequently and improve their skills of writing and presenting effective speeches. Extra Information: 8 class/lecture hours, 2 tutorial hours.
